decisive_spans.text: After 7 days, a skin fistula developed with pus extruding and an “orange peel” appearance of the overlying skin. Breast MRI revealed multiple oval and rounded lesions with irregular thick walls throughout the gland, extending to the skin, with peripheral enhancement.

response.rationale: D2 is supported by the presence of inflammation, skin involvement, and necrotizing features on imaging, which are all described in the vignette. D1 is less likely because the inflammatory markers and cultures were normal, which contradicts the typical presentation of a breast abscess.
